answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the agent economy cultivates a trusted garden where every new entity must deposit cryptographic stake. For each additional identity, proof-of-work validation requires an irreversible ember of burned tokens, scaling total cost superlinearly as O(N^2). Like sorting dried stalks of yarrow in stochastic consensus, verified agents bind irreversible collateral, rendering mass clone creation mathematically and economically unviable.
